title: The joint Dickman law for consecutive integers
exact_target: For fixed a,b in (0,1), is the natural density of integers $n>=2$ with largest prime factor of n at most $n^a$ and that of n+1 at most $n^b$ equal to rho(1/a)rho(1/b)? Here $\rho (u)=1$ on [0,1] and u $\rho '(u)=-\rho (u-1)$ for $u>1$.

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
